claims.text: Clusters were extracted using unsupervised training of word embeddings, which is a popular approach in NLP tasks.
The clusters were evaluated based on their effectiveness in improving performance in sentiment classification and other tasks.
The output of the approach includes a 5-dimensional vector representing the estimated prevalence of categories, indicating the use of clusters in classification tasks.
The clusters were derived from embeddings trained on a large dataset of English tweets, which were pre-processed for analysis.
